New Rudisill Regional Library Opens in Historic Greenwood

October 7, 2026
Natalie Mikles,
SHARE:
  • Facebook
  • Pinterest
  • email
  • Twitter
  • Linkedin
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:15
Instaread

The new Rudisill Regional Library opened Oct. 3 in Tulsa’s Historic Greenwood District, welcoming families to a 33,000-square-foot space designed for learning, creativity and community connection.

One of the highlights is the expanded children’s area, which has doubled in size and offers plenty of room for little ones to explore, play and discover the joy of reading. Young visitors can curl up with a book in a kid-sized car or explore hands-on toys and tactile activities that encourage sensory play. The children’s area also opens to a secure outdoor play space, a unique feature within the Tulsa City-County Library system, complete with a playhouse and opportunities for imaginative play.

Other highlights include the Jeanne B. Goodwin Storytime Room, a Maker Space with a recording studio and musical instruments, and an expanded African American Resource Center, the only one of its kind in Oklahoma.

The new library honors Rudisill’s 50-year history of serving Tulsa families while creating a welcoming destination for future generations.

Learn more at tulsalibrary.org.

Rudisill Regional Library Hours and Contact Information

Address: 1017 N. Greenwood Ave., Tulsa

Hours: 

  • Sunday: 1-5 p.m.
  • Monday-Thursday: 9 a.m.-9 p.m.
  • Friday: 9 a.m.-6 p.m.
  • Saturday: 9 a.m.-5 p.m.
